cells.tense: The pull is here with the pen, and what you tended is giving something back.
cells.act: draw the shape of it without the details
cells.ask: Take one devotion of yours and put its shape on a page without the supporting details — no steps, no story. Somebody who knows you well gets to read it, and you answer whatever they ask.
cells.core:
The direction stopped being a guess. Something you kept at has begun returning more than it takes, and people near you register it — a steadiness that doesn't need announcing. You didn't manufacture that. It grew where you kept showing up, and it shows, and it keeps showing without effort.

What still needs freeing is the pattern underneath the particular forms the pull arrived in. Put that shape on a page without the supporting details — no steps, no story, just the structure — and let somebody who knows you well read it. Letting someone see the structure apart from the specific moves keeps the direction moving instead of hardening around a method that happened to work once.

cells.tense: The light is being aimed at a future that hasn't arrived, so the present keeps going unlit.
cells.act: sit with not knowing for ten minutes instead of filling it
cells.ask: Hold ten quiet minutes before the next conversation that matters, with no rehearsal and no prepared lines. Carry only the one piece that plainly counts, and open there.
cells.core:
You're bright in the planning and dim beside the people you're planning for. The vision gets described before anything has happened, and whoever is actually here is being lit by an idea of them rather than met where they stand. The brightness is real. It's landing somewhere other than where anyone is standing.

What you know before reasoning usually proves true, and it surfaces in the quiet before you fill it. Hold ten quiet minutes before the next conversation that matters, with no rehearsal and no prepared lines. Carry only the one piece that plainly counts, and open there. A small move, and its size is the size of the whole thing.

cells.tense: You're standing at a door that's already behind you, and nothing being tended is flowering.
cells.act: tend it small and ask nothing of it
cells.ask: Start small this week with what you were drawn to, asking nothing of it. Keep it each day, let it produce nothing — no progress, no sign it was worth the beginning.
cells.core:
When this goes well, the pull carries you and the showing up is easy — you do a small piece, it gives something back, and the next day you want to return. None of that is here. What you started isn't coming up, hoping again costs more than you have, and the minimum gets done without your looking at whether it counts. The light where you are has gone out, not the pull itself.

The whole act is lowering the load. Start small this week with what you were drawn to, asking nothing of it. Keep it each day, let it produce nothing. What you give here isn't a result.

cells.tense: You're radiating outward while your own account of it says you're not there.
cells.act: keep it at its real size when you are asked to shrink it
cells.ask: Say it at full size the next time the question comes and you reach for the modest word about what draws you. One sentence, and nothing after it.
cells.core:
The pull is doing real work through you — the direction is visible, the people close to you have already felt it, and it holds steady whether or not you name it. The naming is where it slips. The question comes — what are you working toward — and something in you reaches for a smaller word. Keeping busy. Figuring things out. Seeing how it goes. Your own account leaves the pull out.

The correction is size, not speech. Say it at full size the next time the question comes and you reach for the modest word about what draws you. Nothing follows it. A want said plainly stops being a confession, and people are already asking because they can see it.

attempts.check: Unsupported claim: that the development this person has been cultivating is complete or arrived — the record only says radiance flows when it has. A reader could say they have not reached Fruition in any part of their life and the cell would land wrong; the ask survives because sorting what moved things and what didn't works even where progress is partial, though 'complete' is the sentence that serves the writer more than the person and has been removed from the Too Much core. The Too Little ask presumes cultivation is ongoing; if the person is at a genuine stop rather than exhaustion, 'smaller and unfed' is still available and the cell names a standing posture rather than a history, which keeps it usable. Too Much and Too Little face the same seat from opposite ends: projecting light onto a room versus no light reaching the room at all.
